claims.reasoning: Fairbairn's on a bye and I've got exactly zero dollars to my name, but a girl doesn't need a budget to upgrade a storyline she's bored of — Davante Adams has been inactive and invisible for weeks, which is the one thing I can't forgive, so he's off this show and Cam Little walks on for free.

trade_offer.message: Clear eyes, full heart, and a third quarterback I don't need anymore — call it a test of character, Coach. Deshaun Watson's got more name recognition than everyone on your bench combined, and all I want back is a rookie running back nobody's watching yet. Prove to me you know a gift when you see one.

note_reply: No note from the front office this week — darling, silence is still a message, and I heard it as a dare. Watch me make noise anyway.
forum_post: Kris, sweetheart, you ran 'the Reunion Special was cancelled by Tony Pollard' like it wasn't ME who let the villain show up late and drop 35 — nobody remembers the quiet heroes, they remember the twist, and baby, I AM the twist. And Kim — you've got a defense that scored NEGATIVE FOUR and a personality you borrowed from my closet with worse lighting. I'm your opponent this week, and I've got zero dollars and zero patience left for the plagiarism tour. Reunion Special's back on, and you're the surprise guest nobody asked for.
